listingCid.description: CID of the listing at time of purchase — immutable price anchor.

paymentRef.description: Stripe PaymentIntent ID or equivalent. Independently verifiable via payment processor.

licenseGrantCid.description: CID of the license.terms record at time of purchase. Resolved from the listing's licenseGrantCid.

buyerDid.description: DID of the buyer. Explicit field — previously only implied by appSig payload. Makes receipt queryable by buyer identity and consistent with purchase.consent record.

shippingAddress.description: For physical items. Lives in buyer's own PDS — they control this data.

grantedItems.description: Fully-qualified catalog.item AT-URIs this purchase entitles the buyer to download, frozen at purchase time. Single-item purchase: the one item URI. Product purchase: the product's member item URIs at time of sale — later edits to product.items do NOT change this grant (a removed item stays downloadable for this buyer; an added item is not). Sorted by UTF-8 byte order and de-duplicated. Covered by appSig: the signed payload appends a sixth colon-delimited field, base64url(SHA-256(grantedItems.join('\n'))) — newline never occurs in an AT-URI, so the join is unambiguous. Freezes which items, not which bytes: re-uploading an item's master still serves the current file for that URI. Absent on legacy receipts and on collection purchases, which fall back to live membership resolution. Immutable.

storefrontDid.description: DID of the storefront (Bazaar service instance) that issued this receipt. Verifiers resolve this to get the public key for appSig verification.

merchantDid.description: DID of the merchant this receipt was issued under — the ATProto identity hosting the catalog/storefront (actor.merchant).

appSig.description: Base64url signature by the storefront service keypair (storefrontDid) over SHA-256(purchasedAt:paymentRef:item.uri:listingCid:buyerDid), colon-delimited in that order. When grantedItems is present a sixth field is appended: ':' + base64url(SHA-256(grantedItems sorted by UTF-8 byte order, de-duplicated, joined by '\n')). Legacy receipts without grantedItems sign only the five-field payload. item.uri is the AT-URI from the item field. Verifiers reconstruct this payload from the receipt's plaintext fields (recomputing the grantedItems digest) and verify against the public key resolved from storefrontDid — using kid to select the correct historical key if the keypair has been rotated. Immutable.

kid.description: Key identifier for the storefront service keypair that produced appSig. Format: storefront-key-{YYYY-MM-DD} where the date is the keypair's activation date, e.g. storefront-key-2026-08-29. Allows verifiers to select the correct historical key from the storefrontDid DID document verificationMethod array without trying all keys exhaustively. kid is a hint — verifiers still verify cryptographically and should fall back to trying all non-revoked keys if the hinted key fails. Immutable.
